verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills is a packaging format/feature for Claude and Claude Code, both of which depend on Anthropic's proprietary hosted model API; no evidence anywhere in the pack shows a way to self-host the core Claude model or Claude Code service on your own infrastructure. The probe showing skill files can be installed locally (anthropic-skills-probe-rt-1) only concerns the open SKILL.md format, not self-hosting the underlying AI product itself.
